meta.title: Presence Hospitality | Remote front office & holographic reception for hotels
meta.description: Presence Hospitality runs your hotel reception from a central hub: self check-in plus live receptionists who appear as life-size holograms. Night, day or 24/7.

hero.eyebrow: Presence Hospitality · Front office as a service
hero.lead: A fully staffed reception, without staffing every shift on site. When guests need help, a real receptionist from our Amsterdam hub appears live in your lobby, day or night.
hero.note: Built for independent hotels and hostels · Live in the Netherlands
hero.title: Stop hiring front desk staff.
hero.photoAlt: Presence Hospitality: a guest with her suitcase walking to her room along a modern hotel corridor.

market.line3: Guests still expect a warm welcome at 3 a.m.
market.body: Hotels are under pressure to keep service levels high while protecting margins. Presence Hospitality helps you adapt by centralising reception, without sacrificing the guest experience.

problem.title: The problem
problem.sub: The traditional front desk was built for a different labour market.
problem.c1Body: Rising labour costs and increasing tax pressure (city tax + VAT) squeeze margins. A fully staffed 24/7 desk becomes financially inefficient, especially for smaller properties.
problem.c2Body: Nights and off-peak hours bring long idle time, yet the desk still needs full coverage. Staffing costs stop matching actual guest demand.
problem.c3Body: Staff shortages, high turnover and multi-location complexity make consistent service hard. The guest experience changes from shift to shift and property to property.
problem.chartDesc: Illustrative chart: the desk is staffed at the same level for all 24 hours, while guest demand peaks around check-out in the morning and check-in in the late afternoon and drops close to zero at night. The gap at night is paid idle time.

how.title: How it works
how.sub: From the front door to the room, without a queue, and never without a person when it matters.
how.s1Body: Your guest walks into the lobby. No queue, no bell, no waiting for someone to come back from the back office.
how.s2Body: They enter their last name and booking number. The reservation is pulled from your PMS, ID is verified and payment is taken on the spot.
how.s3Body: A card that won't go through. A booking under a different name. A question about parking.
how.s4Body: The guest presses call on the Holobox. The call goes straight to the Presence Hospitality hub.
how.s5Body: A trained receptionist answers live and appears as a life-size hologram, at eye level, face to face.
how.s6Body: The agent resolves it directly in your systems: payment, key reset, room details. Your guest heads upstairs.
how.ctaLead: Want to see it with your own eyes?
how.kAlertHint: Tap the Holobox to talk to reception
how.sceneDesc: Illustration of a hotel lobby with an entrance, a self check-in kiosk and a Holobox. It changes with each step of the guest journey.
how.carousel: The guest journey, step by step
how.hSayHello: Good evening! Let me sort that out for you.
how.hCardBody: A real receptionist at our hub, live.

experience.body: Mini or full-size, in your lobby or at reception. When a guest presses call, a receptionist appears life-size, at eye level, and helps them on the spot.
experience.stageAlt: Illustration: a Presence Hospitality receptionist appearing as a life-size hologram inside the Holobox.

behind.title: Behind the box
behind.c1Body: In your lobby or at reception, Mini or full-size, with a redundant internet connection.
behind.c2Body: Encrypted link (VPN) to the Presence Hospitality hub, with monitoring and privacy signage on site.
behind.c3Body: Check-in and check-out, ID verification, key resets, payments, questions and upsell.
behind.c4Body: SLA playbooks, a local contact and a clear security escalation path.
behind.c5Body: KPIs such as wait times, first contact resolution and NPS, plus audit logs and quality reviews.

benefits.title: What changes when the desk moves to the hub
benefits.aTitle: The same welcome, at every hour.
benefits.aBody: Real, trained receptionists and hospitality-first processes give every guest the same high standard, at every hour and every location, without the limits of on-site staffing.
benefits.bSuffix: savings on front office costs, while keeping full coverage.
benefits.bFallback: Centralising the desk removes idle time, so you pay for service, not for waiting.
benefits.footnote: Estimate based on the Presence Hospitality operating model. Actual savings depend on property size, service hours and volume.
benefits.cBody: Night, day, or around the clock. Coverage from one central hub.
benefits.dTitle: Start with one property. Add more later.
benefits.dBody: Open integrations and full ownership of your data. Add a second property without adding a second desk. No vendor lock-in.
benefits.eBody: A monthly service fee based on your rooms, service hours and volume. No overtime, no last-minute replacements to organise.

integrations.title: Works with the systems you already run
integrations.body: Reservations, guest data, keys and payments flow between the kiosk, the Holobox, our hub and your PMS, so our agents see exactly what your guest sees. You keep full ownership of your data.
integrations.small: Using a different PMS? Tell us in your demo request and we'll review compatibility.
integrations.desc: Diagram: the Holobox, the self check-in kiosk and chat & phone connect to the Presence hub, which connects to Mews (PMS), GauVendi (booking engine), Hotek, payments and access systems.

who.r2Body: No more gaps in the rota. Consistent service across every shift and property.
who.r3Body: Standardised workflows, clear escalation paths and dashboards you can review.

steps.title: Intake & site survey
steps.body: We learn how your hotel runs today (rooms, team, systems, service hours) and walk the full guest journey with you: booking, pre-arrival, check-in, stay and check-out.
steps.get: A clear picture of your current front office

steps.title: Service design
steps.body: Together we agree the scope: hours, languages, channels and service levels, what stays on site, and who is called when something escalates.
steps.get: A service scope you sign off on

steps.title: Holobox installation
steps.body: We install the Mini or full-size Holobox and set up a redundant, secure network connection to our hub.

steps.title: Integration
steps.body: We connect your PMS, access systems, payment processing and ID verification, with the right roles and permissions.

steps.title: Playbook & training

faq.title: Questions hotel owners ask us
faq.stillBody: Email us, we're happy to walk you through it.

pms.q: Do we need to replace our PMS?
pms.a: No. We work with your existing systems and connect to them. Mews is supported today; using something else? Tell us in your demo request and we'll check compatibility.

kiosk.q: What happens if the kiosk can't solve a guest's problem?
kiosk.a: The guest calls from the Holobox and a trained receptionist answers live, as a life-size hologram. The agent resolves it directly in your systems: payments, bookings, key resets.

night.q: Is someone really available at 3 a.m.?
night.a: Yes. Our hub runs 24/7. With the Night-Only package, every late arrival, question and incident is handled remotely, and security escalation follows clear protocols with your local contact.

agents.a: Trained hospitality professionals: our own core team plus certified hospitality partners, all trained to the same standards and SOPs.

staff.q: Do we still need staff on site?
staff.a: That's your choice. During onboarding we agree exactly what stays on site and what the hub handles. Many hotels start with nights only.

channels.a: The Holobox in your lobby, plus chat and telephone.

pricing.a: A one-time setup (Holobox hardware or lease, installation, integrations), a monthly fee based on rooms, service hours and volume, and an optional variable component. Book a demo for a proposal.

timeline.a: It depends on your systems and scope. You'll get a concrete timeline after the intake and site survey.

where.a: We're live in the Netherlands and expanding across Europe.

internet.q: What happens if the internet goes down?
internet.a: Every Holobox runs on a redundant internet connection to our hub. The fallback procedures for your hotel are agreed during onboarding and ready before we go live.

device.q: What if the Holobox or the kiosk is unavailable?
device.a: Guests can also reach our hub by chat and telephone. What happens on site is part of the fallback procedures we agree with you before go-live.

emergency.q: What if a guest becomes aggressive, or there is a physical emergency?
emergency.a: Security escalation follows clear protocols. We coordinate with your local contact or security partner, as agreed in your service design.

remote.q: What happens when something can't be solved remotely?
remote.a: Before go-live we agree what stays on site and who is called when something escalates. Your hotel always has a local contact.

nights.q: Can I start with nights only?
nights.a: Yes. Many hotels start with Night-Only: late arrivals, guest questions and incidents are handled remotely, with no night staff on site. You can move to Day + Evening or 24/7 later.

about.title: About us | Presence Hospitality
about.description: About Presence Hospitality: the remote front office for hotels, based in Amsterdam. Who we are, what we do and how to reach us.
about.sub: We did not start with a hologram. We started with a hotel staffing problem.
about.who1: Presence Hospitality is based in Amsterdam and built by people who come from restaurants, bars, cafés and hotels. The technology is new; the operational understanding of hospitality is not.
about.who2: That is why we sell a staffed reception, not a device. Trained receptionists work from our hub in Amsterdam. Guests check in on their own, and when they need a person, a receptionist appears in the lobby as a life-size hologram inside the Holobox.
